Category: Super Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 10,000eb - 1 Month

Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6) • Install: Hospital

Restraint is for losers.

Iconic Neuralware. Borgware. Requires Newton Module and takes 1 Neuralware Option Slot. When installed, this cyberware improves the efficiency of all other installed cyberware with a built-in cooldown or recharge, reducing it by half (Minimum 3 seconds [1 Round]). This stacks with Newton Module’s usual cooldown reduction for one specific piece of installed cyberware.

Fabrication: DV29 - 10,000eb - 1 Month
Type: Neuralware
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Super Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.
  • Counts as Borgware for Maximum Humanity Loss; the sheet doesn't track that, so apply it by hand.
  • Unlike most Iconic cyberware, this one consumes an Option Slot, as Corgo states.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Cyberware).
